introHtml: Full color decoration on hot cold packs lets you print logos, safety instructions, or wellness messaging in vivid detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color supports gradients and photographic images, making your brand stand out on breakroom shelves or first aid kits. Ideal for corporate wellness programs or construction site giveaways, these packs combine practical relief with eye-catching design. The Gel Bead Hot/Cold Pack-Full Color is a popular choice for its comfortable flexibility and vibrant print surface.
